Hi Lydia — thanks for the trace and W9.

I looked through the SAML trace quickly and saw the assertion is arriving but our portal is rejecting it at the verification step; the error string points to a relayState mismatch (the portal compares an internally generated relay token to the relay value in the assertion). Two likely causes:

1) The invite link contains a short-lived relay token that our front-end issues when the invite was created; if the invite was re-sent or the portal retried the redirect, the token can rotate and the assertion relayState won't line up.
2) NameID format — our endpoint expects an emailNameID (urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress). If Okta is sending persistentNameID, we may reject.

Immediate next steps I can take:
- Reissue a fresh invite (will invalidate the old relay token) — I can do this now if you confirm you can test within 30 minutes.
- If that fails, Ben can grant a one-time acceptance bypass so you can complete onboarding while we fix IdP metadata.

Can you confirm the NameID format your IdP is currently sending (email / persistent)? Also please attach the Okta SAML metadata file if convenient (or a link to the metadata).

I'll hold off on reissuing until I hear back so we don't churn tokens.

Thanks,
Karthik
